latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor AI HD – effortless AI-powered HD video editing in the cloud.

- Upload raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe your editing needs.
- AI automatically trims shaky parts, enhances resolution to HD (1080p), and adds transitions.
- Rapid cloud rendering workflow designed for YouTubers and content creators.
- Seamless session setup, credit handling, and export/download with simple prompts.
- Supports timeline edits including aspect ratio changes, text overlays, and background music.
